# Aleph Printing & Graphics — Full Site Guide for LLMs
# https://aleph.com.lb

## Company
Aleph Printing and Graphics was founded in 1972 in Mekalles, Beirut, Lebanon. It is one of the first printing houses established in Lebanon. Originally specialized in color separation and reproduction, it has grown into a full-service commercial printing company processing 150 tons of paper per month with 37 employees.

## Services
- Luxury rigid hard boxes and soft boxes
- Label printing (food, beverage, pharmaceutical, cosmetic)
- Pharmaceutical leaflets and package inserts
- Food-safe packaging and carton boxes
- Security printing (envelopes, serialised documents, anti-counterfeit)
- Book and publication printing (offset, perfect binding, saddle stitch, hardcover)
- Brochures, leaflets, business cards
- Branded shopping bags
- Graphic design services
- Binding (saddle stitch, perfect binding, wire-o, spiral, hardcover case binding)

## Industries served
- Pharmaceutical
- Food and beverage
- Cosmetics and beauty
- Luxury goods
- Book publishing
- Security and institutional
- Retail and commercial
